metadata.title: NBM: an Open Dataset for the Acoustic Monitoring of Nocturnal Migratory Birds in Europe
metadata.description:
This is the dataset presented in the paper "NBM: an Open Dataset for the Acoustic Monitoring of Nocturnal Migratory Birds in Europe", which can be found here: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.03633.

 

Update 2025, November 7th

- A Data_statistics csv splitting bird species by total annotation and recording numbers has been added to the repository, for a quick look at the bird species distribution in the dataset.

Update 2025, June 13th

- A metadata file can now be found alongside the dataset ("metadata.csv"): it contains the recording date for original NBM files whenever available, and date and location for all but two of the files originating from Xeno-Canto. All audio samples in the train_nbm_orig folder were recorded in France, but no precise location is available for this collection.

- Irregularities due to unconstrained text input in several annotation files have been fixed; in particular all annotated parasitic and background noise are now gathered in two classes: 0: Background and 0: Other biophonia. Unidentified bird vocalizations fall under the Other category.

 

File description

Files come in three directories: train_nbm_orig, train_nbm_xc and test.

Each is composed of a list of .wav files with its .txt annotations file. All bird vocalizations are linked to a species and are annotated both in time and frequency.

The train dataset is composed of a total of  2,077 audio files and 13,359 annotations, for a total of ~38 hours of recording. Among these, 883 files were downloaded from Xeno-canto and finely hand-annotated.

License

Data samples are distributed under various licenses depending on their origin: all samples from the original NBM database (source 'src' marked as 'NBM-Orig.' in the metadata file) are provided under CC BY 4.0. Files originating from xeno-canto (having 'XC' in the 'src' field of the metadata file) retain their original license (see the 'lic' column of the metadata).
